style: Style: match the attached style reference image EXACTLY (it shows the in-game combat look). Painted cut-paper puppet art: every part is a flat paper piece with rough hand-cut edges, thin dark outlines, small soft drop shadows between overlapping layers, bold simplified shapes, painterly brush texture inside flat shapes, NOT realistic rendering, NOT a photo-like painting. Dark and tense, low saturation charcoal, sand and tarnished bronze palette with blood-red accents, torch light from the left. No text, no letters, no watermark, no border.

presets.portrait: 512x512 square head-and-shoulders portrait (bust) of the same kind of paper puppet character as in the reference, face slightly turned (3/4 view), face centered horizontally with the eyes at about 42% from the top, shoulders reaching the bottom edge. Head, neck, torso armor pieces and hair are separate cut-paper layers. Plain dark charcoal background (#14110F) with a faint warm glow behind the head. Paper-cut blood splatter and grime on skin and armor.
presets.icon: 128x128 square icon on a fully TRANSPARENT background (alpha channel, no background color at all). A single bold silhouette symbol in tarnished bronze (#B08A4F) with subtle painterly texture and a thin dark outline, centered with small padding. Flat, readable at 24px.
presets.crest: 256x256 square heraldic shield crest on a fully TRANSPARENT background (alpha channel). Painted bronze-rimmed shield, centered.
presets.wide: Wide painterly background image. Very dark overall so light UI text stays readable on top of it.
